english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese description for an adjective used in predicate position, as in 做謂語嘅形容詞.

examples.english: In this sentence, “開心” is a predicative adjective.
examples.traditional: 「開心」擺喺句尾做謂語，就係做謂語嘅形容詞。
